name: casper-hansen/big-moe-small-box
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash runs at 15 tokens/s on an RTX 3090
summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 ran at about 15 tokens/s on a home RTX 3090 build, with the inference setup and parts list published for a roughly $2,500 box. A follow-up says that rate is about 3x slower than an API served at 100 tokens/s, because much of the wait is now in tool calls.
